body.message:
Please note that, as per the latest update received from the building management, the rate for the extension has been revised. The updated rate for your extended stay will be AED 14,780.77.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. However, due to the recent changes implemented by the new management, the rates have been adjusted accordingly. We have made every effort to secure the most competitive rate possible, and this is currently the best rate we are able to offer.

We greatly appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this matter.
